description: Rolepod Codex hooks. Shared entries mirror root hooks/*.sh byte-exact (Codex uses the same event names, stdin JSON, and hookSpecificOutput/permissionDecision protocol as Claude — verified against the official hooks reference, 2026-08-05). Codex-only: agent-sync.sh (SessionStart → the Codex manifest has no agents component, so the plugin bundles agents/rolepod-*.toml + agents/AGENTS.rolepod.md and this hook copies them into ~/.codex/agents/ and refreshes ONLY the rolepod block of ~/.codex/AGENTS.md when the plugin version changes — `codex plugin marketplace upgrade` alone is then a complete update; ROLEPOD_AGENT_SYNC_OFF=1 disables). Codex now exposes SubagentStart/SubagentStop/Stop, so session-lifecycle (cross-CLI sibling locks) is registered; still Claude-only: worktree-guard (apply_patch input shape has no file_path field). block-subagent-commit (deny) is also registered on PreToolUse:Bash with `--cli codex` (only the commit ban runs there; the cannot-wait rules are Claude-only): a sub-agent's `git commit` / `git push` is denied — a child's PreToolUse carries `agent_id` (live probe 2026-09-30, Codex 0.159). SubagentStart (default|explorer|worker) runs subagent-core.sh --cli codex: the built-in children get the rolepod sub-agent core; claim-verify-nudge stays silent for a payload with an `agent_id`. Hooks fire natively on Codex >=0.144, default-enabled via [features] hooks = true (the legacy plugin_hooks opt-in flag was removed upstream); plugin-bundled hooks must be trusted by the user before they run.
